name: doc-regen
description: Master orchestrator to update all documentation with the latest codebase changes. Coordinates text updates, visual UI snapshots, and documentation discovery.

actions.name: regenerate documentation
actions.description: Performs a complete synchronization: identifies stale docs, updates Markdown text, and refreshes UI screenshots. (Triggers: 'update the documentation', 'sync all docs', 'update the user-guide document', 'regen technical documentation')

steps.description: Executing the unified Documentation Regeneration Pipeline.

actions.name: check documentation status
actions.description: Checks if the documentation is up to date with the codebase without making changes. (Triggers: 'is my documentation up to date?', 'check doc staleness')
